walkFirst.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game character walk sprite atlas for Void Sun, an original adult fantasy pixel-art tactical RPG inspired by the refined sprites of Sword of Convallaria.
Input image: the supplied characters-builds-v3.png is ONLY a design/style reference for adult faces, pixel clusters, clothing materials. Do not recreate the sample board or its background.
Primary request: One and the SAME adult female adventurer, about 28 years old, short auburn hair cut ABOVE the nape, small mature eyes, defined adult jaw, athletic normal physique, modest practical forest-green sleeveless tunic with cream collar, brown trousers, leather belt, gloves and boots. No weapon, no helmet, no cape. Compact tactical sprite proportions approx 3.7 heads tall; NOT a child, not huge anime eyes, not a bodybuilder. Keep coherent identity and proportions across every view.
Exactly 48 separate sprites in a STRICT 6 columns x 8 rows rectangular uniform grid on a truly transparent background. Each cell square; total canvas aspect 3:4. No grid lines, labels, text, scenery, shadow disk, border or watermark. Six consecutive WALK poses left-to-right in each row, a complete natural looping walk cycle: contact, down/recoil, passing, opposite contact, down/recoil, passing. Alternate feet and opposite arms. Small forward travel in the pose but character stays centered in its cell; keep head and torso scale unchanged. At least 15% transparent margin per cell, feet ground line constant. Show both hands. No exaggerated squat, jumping, or jogging. Carefully drawn contact/passing poses, bent knees, weight transfer, natural body rhythm, same physical foot size.
EIGHT TRUE VIEWS, one view per row, never duplicates. Fixed orthographic tactical camera elevated about 30 degrees, NOT overhead, NOT ground-level:
ROW 1: FRONT facing viewer south, face fully visible.
ROW 2: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing screen down-right southeast, face visible.
ROW 3: RIGHT PROFILE facing screen right east, nose points right.
ROW 4: BACK THREE-QUARTER facing screen up-right northeast, mostly rear head.
ROW 5: FULL BACK facing away north, NO face.
ROW 6: BACK THREE-QUARTER facing screen up-left northwest.
ROW 7: LEFT PROFILE facing screen left west, nose points left.
ROW 8: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing screen down-left southwest, face visible.
All 8 rows share EXACTLY the same sprite height, head size, outfit, face, hair, and foot baseline. The pixel art must be beautiful and deliberately hand-crafted: crisp square pixel clusters, selective dark outline, limited coherent warm natural palette, 3-4 shaded tones per material, readable adult face, rich yet disciplined shading. Pixel structure consistent throughout, no blurry photographic texture, no antialias haze, no smooth 3D dolls, no long hair, no giant head. This is a usable animation atlas, not concept illustrations. Spend care on actual anatomical rotation and continuous leg/arm motion across the six poses.

walk.prompt:
Edit target: the supplied transparent 6x8 sprite atlas.
Keep the same ONE female adventurer identity, short auburn hair, green cream-trimmed tunic, brown trousers/gloves/boots, adult face, compact refined fantasy pixel art. Keep exactly the 8 row orientations unchanged: front, front-right, right profile, rear-right, rear, rear-left, left profile, front-left.
The critical correction is WALK ANIMATION: the current six columns mostly repeat the SAME leg. Redraw all six poses as a real complete alternating walk cycle. This must not be six similar pictures of one stride. Track the character's ANATOMICAL right/left legs.
In EVERY row, column 1 = right foot forward planted, left foot back; col 2 = right foot supports weight, left knee lifts and travels forward; col 3 = left foot passes under/just ahead of hips, right foot behind; col 4 = LEFT foot forward planted, RIGHT foot back (the exact opposite stride from col 1); col 5 = left foot supports weight, right knee lifts and travels forward; col 6 = right foot passes under/just ahead of hips, left foot behind. Arms move OPPOSITE their own leg. In profile rows this alternating leg cycle must be unmistakable and pose 1/4 silhouette different. Character travels toward facing direction, including north/south directions using believable foreshortening, never sideways skating. Keep torso/head consistent and feet grounding accurate.
Maintain exactly 6 columns x 8 rows, completely transparent backdrop, sprites centered with generous empty margins so neighbouring cells never touch. Full bodies visible, no feet cropped. Preserve adult appearance: slightly smaller eyes, firmer jaw, less round cheeks, no child face. Crisp intentional square pixel clusters and restrained selective outlines, no smooth shaded rendering or blur. No text labels no drawn grid no weapons no helmets no cape. Do not change costume or add accessories. This is a production WALK sprite atlas requiring six genuinely distinct sequential poses per direction.

idle.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: idle turnaround sprite atlas for the SAME original Void Sun adult female adventurer shown in reference walk atlas.
Reference image role: identity, costume, pixel-art rendering and eight exact views. Redraw ONLY standing idle poses. Do not copy walk poses.
Exactly EIGHT separate full-body sprites in a strict 4 columns x 2 rows grid, wide canvas aspect 2:1. Truly transparent backdrop; no lines, text, labels, scenery, shadows, vignette or watermark. Generous 15% transparent padding within each cell, all feet on the same local baseline. Every character same scale and proportions. One character, not eight designs.
Read left-to-right:
top row: FRONT (face to viewer), front-right THREE QUARTER, RIGHT PROFILE (nose right), rear-right THREE QUARTER.
bottom row: FULL BACK (no face), rear-left THREE QUARTER, LEFT PROFILE (nose left), front-left THREE QUARTER.
Orthographic tactical camera elevated 30 degrees, same as reference. Both boots planted on ground, relaxed balanced stance with feet shoulder-width, elbows soft, hands at sides, no walk, no lifted foot, no contrapposto, no dramatic gesture.
Adult woman approx 28, short auburn hair above nape, firm adult jaw, restrained small eyes, no childish cheeks. Green sleeveless tunic, cream collar and hem, brown trousers, leather belt with brass buckle, brown gloves/bracers and boots. No helmet, no weapon, no shoulder armour, no cape. Maintain reference hair shape and SAME identity around all directions.
Professional original fantasy pixel art in the refined tactical sprite spirit of Sword of Convallaria: compact adult proportions around 3.7 heads tall, deliberate crisp pixel clusters, limited palette with rich controlled 3-4 tone shading, selective dark outline. No blurred painterly texture, no realistic dolls, no oversized anime eyes. Carefully ensure genuine 45 degree increments through all eight directions and consistent head/neck/torso alignment.

equipment.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: modular equipment sprite atlas for ONE adult human female character in Void Sun.
Input reference is the SAME character's idle turnaround. Match its pixel art, exact head anatomy, adult face and tactical orthographic camera elevated 30 degrees. These are ORIGINAL fitted equipment pieces for that character, not arbitrary icons.
Exactly 24 isolated pieces in a STRICT EIGHT COLUMNS x THREE ROWS grid on a truly transparent background, wide aspect ratio 8:3. Transparent gutters and generous padding so all pieces are isolated. NO text, labels, numbers, grid lines, scenery, full bodies or shadows.
Columns have these EXACT view directions, shared by all THREE rows:
1 front south, 2 front-right southeast, 3 right profile east, 4 rear-right northeast, 5 full back north, 6 rear-left northwest, 7 left profile west, 8 front-left southwest.
ROW 1: Eight fitted HELMETED HEADS. Draw the character's entire head and short neck with an elegant practical open-face blue-grey steel helmet, small brass edge trim, sculpted crown, neat cheek guards. Preserve the SAME adult female face where visible, fully rear head on back view, proper profile nose on side views. Helmet surrounds the skull correctly with clearance, not a bowl buried in hair. All auburn hair is tucked away under the helmet. No enormous pauldrons, horns, crests or face-obscuring visor. The bare face is part of this fitted head variant.
ROW 2: Eight isolated SLEEVELESS CUIRASSES only, from cream collar to waist. No head, no arms, no shoulders, no hands, no legs, no human flesh. Blue-grey steel breastplate with subtle brass edging, cream collar rim, brown belt at waist. Shape it to EXACTLY the character torso from reference, normal athletic adult physique. Rich but controlled pixel shading. Each front/back/profile view depicts actual geometry, no identical frontal icons.
ROW 3: Eight isolated HELD SWORDS, one longsword in the character's anatomical right hand grip. ONLY sword blade, brass crossguard, brown grip; NO drawn hand/arm/body. Grip at upper end, blade points DOWN slightly outward at rest. Blade silver with cool highlight, simple elegant geometry. Show the appropriate front/edge perspective in all eight directions. All blades the SAME length. Do not turn a sword into an axe or spear. Keep the entire sword and grip in each cell.
Pixel art rendering: same fine deliberate square pixel clusters, selective dark outline and disciplined warm/cool palette as reference, crisp small pixel RPG equipment, no photographic noise, no smooth glossy 3D render, no blur. This grid is to be cropped into separate fitted layers, so every piece must have clean transparent silhouette and consistent dimensions across views.

preparation: prepare.py: crops, transparent sprite packing, nearest-neighbour resize, explicit per-frame anchors and cover polygons; head-only auburn coverage mask with two-pixel dark-contour margin; no generated replacement artwork.
